{{Quote|It is protected by an energy shield which is generated from the nearby Forest Moon of Endor. The shield must be deactivated if any attack is to be attempted.|Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], regarding the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|assault]] on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A '''deflector shield generator''', or simply a '''shield generator''', was any device used to create a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]], including both [[Particle shield/Legends|particle]] and [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielding]].

==Description==
[[File:FambaaShield-SWE.png|thumb|300px|left|Gungan deflector shield generators were carried by fambaas.]]
A deflector shield generator created a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] that used several shield projectors positioned around a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to wrap the vessel in a protective shell. Smaller vessels, such as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], used a single shield generator, while larger vessels utilized multiple generators. During combat, a shield projector would burn out its matrix board rather than flood the generator itself with energy that could destroy it. On larger ships, damaged shield projectors could be swapped out by maintenance crews in a matter of [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Deflector shield generators were produced in a variety of sizes, ranging from small personal projectors to large units used on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. In some cases, the generator could project the shield a great distance and without need for line of sight, by using a focusing dish. Variants included planetary shield generators, such as the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 planetary shield generator]] used to protect the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] in orbit over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and the [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|DSS-02 shield generator]] used to protect [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] used handheld shield generators along with shield generators on the backs of their [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaas]]. The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] used a force shield projector to protect their base on [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].

Shield generators were used on [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] as well, both custom and factory-built models. Typically low-output, these shield generators were installed within the cockpit and were meant to protect the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|pilot]] from exhaust wash and debris kicked up by the engines. In most instances, the shields were useless in a crash, though some racers invested in full-spectrum generators to protect themselves and their vehicle from destruction.<ref name="EV" />
